payload.description_html: Gongshuilong is a medium-sized saurolophine hadrosaur reaching approximately 7 m in total body length. It is characterized by the distinct sail-like structure down the length of its tail. Like all hadrosaurs, Gongshuilong had a beak at the front of its snout, and batteries of teeth for processing its herbivorous diet.
